evidence: Modifies RPC and REST endpoints (src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp, src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp, src/rest.cpp) and adds structured error data support in src/rpc/request.*.
rationale: Extends JSON-RPC error reporting with candidate block hashes when target blocks are pruned. Commands like getrawtransaction, gettxoutproof, and REST /tx provide structured error responses that enable callers to fetch missing blocks via getblockfrompeer.
